q.line: From the string of happy accidents
stanza: So I wrapped my head in bandages
From the string of happy accidents
I guess maybe I asked for it
But who am I to say?

partner.line: So I wrapped my head in bandages

stanza: I used to never wear a seatbelt
And I didn't see the point
And when I'm pitched through the windshield
I hope the last thing that I felt before the pavement
I hope my soul goes too
